svg.title: From the car to the steering
svg.desc: The steering gear sits across the front axle region. The column reaches it in this left-hand-drive layout; hydraulic lines run to the engine-driven pump behind the seats. UK right-hand-drive gear and line variants differ. The column turns the pinion, the rack moves both track rods, and the front carriers steer. The pump assists that mechanical path. The rim supports the tyre at its bead seats; the tyre meets the road. Numbered parts: 1 Wheel and column; 2 Rack and assistance; 3 Pump and reservoir; 4 Supply and return; 5 Left rod and carrier; 6 Right rod and carrier; 7 17-inch front rim; 8 Front tyre and beads. Explanatory separation, not a workshop sequence.
